title: Collaborative relational time without a global clock: Reproducibility materials for finite event networks
description: Version 2.0.0 reproducibility archive for the manuscript 'Collaborative relational time without a global clock: Reconstruction, partial gluing, and gauge-invariant calibration structure in finite event networks'. The archive broadens the v1.x temporal-domain record to include the early successor chain from regional informational locality through conditional global-coordinate redundancy and staged local-clock/calibration reconstruction, followed by collaborative reconstructibility, lifecycle, temporal atlases, finite scalar deconditioning, typed partial gluing, and finite gauge/Hodge/provenance-balance structure. Claims are finite and structural; the archive does not establish universal temporal emergence, continuum spacetime, Lorentz symmetry, gravity, physical curvature, or a Noether charge.
